paper.title_en: Reconstruction of Dynamical Dark Energy and Gravity from latest cosmological data
paper.abstract_en: Recent cosmological observations have renewed interest in non-standard late-time evolution. We investigate whether departures from the standard expansion history are accompanied by modifications of gravitational dynamics through a joint, non-parametric reconstruction of the effective dark energy density, $Ω_{\rm X}(a)$, and the gravitational response functions $μ(a)$ and $Σ(a)$. Combining CMB, DESI DR2 BAO, Pantheon+, and large scale structure observations, including DES Year 3 $6\times2$pt data, we perform reconstructions with and without a theory motivated correlation prior derived from stable Horndeski models. We find a persistent maximum in $Ω_{\rm X}$ at $z\simeq0.5$--$0.7$, corresponding to a crossing of the effective phantom divide. This feature is already present in the CMB+BAO combination and remains robust when modifications to clustering and lensing are allowed. The reconstructed gravitational response exhibits suggestive enhancements in $μ$ and $Σ$ over approximately the same redshift range, although these departures are less significant. Including LSS information instead favours a reduced lensing response, $Σ<1$, while leaving the background feature largely unchanged. An interpretation within Generalized Brans-Dicke theories illustrates how modifications to the effective gravitational coupling and a scalar-mediated fifth force may contribute to these trends. Our results indicate that current departures from $Λ$CDM are most significant in the expansion history, while leaving open the possibility of correlated modifications to gravitational dynamics that future Stage IV surveys can test.

decision.title_zh: 从最新宇宙学数据重建动力学暗能量与引力
decision.abstract_zh: 近期的宇宙学观测重新激起了对非标准晚期演化的兴趣。我们通过联合、非参数地重建有效暗能量密度 $Ω_{\rm X}(a)$ 以及引力响应函数 $μ(a)$ 和 $Σ(a)$，研究对标准膨胀历史的偏离是否伴随引力动力学的修改。结合 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、Pantheon+ 以及大尺度结构观测（包括 DES Year 3 $6\times2$pt 数据），我们在有和没有由稳定 Horndeski 模型导出的理论动机相关先验的情况下进行重建。我们发现 $Ω_{\rm X}$ 在 $z\simeq0.5$--$0.7$ 处持续存在一个极大值，对应于有效幻影分界（phantom divide）的穿越。这一特征在 CMB+BAO 组合中已经存在，并且在允许对成团和透镜效应进行修改时依然稳健。重建的引力响应在大致相同的红移范围内表现出 $μ$ 和 $Σ$ 的暗示性增强，尽管这些偏离的显著性较低。纳入 LSS 信息反而倾向于减弱的透镜响应，$Σ<1$，同时基本不改变背景特征。在广义 Brans-Dicke 理论中的解释说明了有效引力耦合的修改和标量媒介的第五力如何可能促成这些趋势。我们的结果表明，当前对 $Λ$CDM 的偏离在膨胀历史上最为显著，同时保留了引力动力学相关修改的可能性，未来 Stage IV 巡天可以检验这一点。
